description: Return the KB glossary entry for an explicitly requested glossary definition or exact glossary term. No preliminary graph call is required for a glossary request. For a general question such as what RSI means, why it behaves that way, or which indicators complement it, start with query_knowledge op=ask. Exact lookup is case-insensitive and may return partial matches. Answer from the returned definition when sufficient; do not routinely follow it with graph or document searches.

term.description: The term to look up, case-insensitive.

name: kb_glossary_get
